name: What is the typical cost range for building a pool house in the Las Vegas area?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for building a pool house in the Las Vegas area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building a pool house in the Las Vegas area can vary significantly, generally ranging from $30,000 to over $150,000. Factors influencing this range include the size of the structure, complexity of the design, chosen materials, inclusion of plumbing or electrical work, and interior finishes like kitchens or bathrooms. A basic storage shed style will be on the lower end, while a fully-equipped guest house will be on the higher end.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pool house costs in Las Vegas typically range from $30,000 to over $150,000, depending on size, design complexity, materials, and amenities.
